'''Balawai meatpie''' was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]] containing [[Foodstuff/Legends|meat]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nick Rostu]] once described a wound he received from a [[vibroshield]]<ref name="cnI" /> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes that ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' takes place two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of {{Film|III}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. As [[Nick Rostu]] received the wound three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of ''Jedi Twilight'', he must have received it around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> as opening him up like an overcooked Balawai meatpie. The pie shared its name with<ref name="cnI" /> the [[Balawai]], a group of settlers who lived on<ref name="balawai">{{CSWECite|I|56|Balawai}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].<ref name="Haruun">{{CSWECite|II|23|Haruun Kal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Balawai meatpie was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'', written by [[Michael Reaves]] as the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Coruscant Nights]]'' trilogy.<ref name="cnI" />
